As the CEO and Principal Consultant at Consule Solutions, I help our customers to reach higher business efficiency with the help of NetSuite best practices and tools. I lead a team of certified NetSuite consultants and developers who deliver customized solutions that meet the unique needs of each client.

With over 9 years of experience in NetSuite implementation, I have a deep understanding of the NetSuite platform and its capabilities. I am skilled in designing and configuring NetSuite modules, including ERP, Multibook, and DSI, to optimize the current business processes and workflows. I have successfully completed multiple NetSuite projects for a wide range of industries, such as manufacturing, retail, distribution, and services, achieving high customer satisfaction and retention rates.
